info.title: OpenConnector Register
info.description: Integration platform register for the OpenConnector Nextcloud app. Manages Sources (outbound integrations), Endpoints (inbound API), Consumers (subscribers), Event/EventMessage/EventSubscription (event bus), Job/Mapping/Rule (workflow engine), Synchronization/SynchronizationContract (sync triad), and the four log schemas (CallLog, JobLog, SynchronizationLog, SynchronizationContractLog).

x-openregister.description: OpenConnector data model — thin client on OpenRegister; 15 schemas (11 mutable config + 4 append-only log). Replaces the 15 hand-rolled lib/Db/<Entity>Mapper.php classes shipped pre-chain-B.

openconnector.title: OpenConnector
openconnector.description: Integration platform register — Sources, Endpoints, Consumers, Events, Jobs, Mappings, Rules, Synchronizations + 4 log schemas.

source.title: Source
source.summary: An outbound integration target (HTTP API, database, or service)
source.description: A Source is the integration counterpart for inbound or outbound data exchange. It defines the connection (location, auth, headers) and operational state (rate limits, retention, last-call timestamps). One half of the Source/Synchronization/Contract triad — see local ADR-005.

auth.description: Authentication strategy slug (apikey, basic, oauth, jwt, none)

authenticationConfig.description: Provider-specific auth configuration (object). Credential strings here are stored plaintext per local ADR-007 until EncryptionService ships (local ADR-016).

authorizationPassthroughMethod.description: How auth flows to the upstream target

accept.description: Default Accept header for outbound requests

documentation.description: Public docs URL for the upstream API

loggingConfig.description: Per-source override for CallLog retention windows

oas.description: OpenAPI spec URL or inline reference for the upstream

headers.description: Default headers applied to outbound requests

translationConfig.description: Mapping/translation hooks applied to outbound payloads

endpointsConfig.description: Per-endpoint overrides nested under this source

logRetention.description: Per-source override for success log retention. Stored in seconds (legacy Source.php convention); JobService DEFAULT_SUCCESS_LOG_RETENTION is 3600000 ms = 3600 s. See chain-B Note on retention unit conversion.

errorRetention.description: Per-source override for error log retention. Stored in seconds; JobService DEFAULT_ERROR_LOG_RETENTION is 2592000000 ms = 2592000 s = P30D.

objectCount.description: Cached count of objects in this source's last sync

test.description: Whether to run in test/dry-run mode

rateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window

rateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp when the rate-limit window resets

lastCall.description: Timestamp of the most recent outbound call

lastSync.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful sync

configurations.description: Configuration profile slugs this source participates in

slug.description: Machine-readable identifier for cross-environment portability (local ADR-015)

consumer.title: Consumer
consumer.description: A Consumer is an event-bus subscriber (webhook target, AMQP queue, etc.). Paired with EventSubscription (filter) and EventMessage (delivery record). See local ADR-013 for the event-bus model.

domains.description: Allowed source domains (CIDR-style or hostname patterns)

authorizationType.description: Auth strategy used by this consumer

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that created the consumer (null for system-created)

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.summary: An inbound API endpoint mapping to a target (register/schema, api, job, synchronization)
endpoint.description: An Endpoint exposes openconnector's inbound surface. Each endpoint has a polymorphic targetType/targetId pair (see local ADR-008) and routes incoming requests to the right kernel. Supports per-endpoint input/output mapping + rule pipelines.

endpointRegex.description: Compiled regex used by the dispatch router

targetType.description: Polymorphic target kind: `register/schema`, `api`, `job`, `synchronization`. See local ADR-008.

targetId.description: Polymorphic target identifier. Shape depends on targetType: for `register/schema` → `<register>/<schema>` slug pair; for `api` → integer Source PK (legacy) or UUID (post-chain-B); for `job` → integer Job PK or UUID; for `synchronization` → integer Synchronization PK or UUID. See local ADR-008 + chain-B sourceId overload documentation.

inputMapping.description: Mapping slug applied to incoming request payload

outputMapping.description: Mapping slug applied to outgoing response payload

rules.description: Ordered list of Rule slugs applied to this endpoint

configurations.description: Configuration profile slugs this endpoint participates in

event.title: Event
event.description: An Event is a CloudEvents v1.0-shaped record (source/type/specversion/time/data). Events are matched against EventSubscriptions to produce EventMessages. See local ADR-013 for the event-bus model.

source.description: CloudEvents `source` attribute — the producing component identity

time.description: CloudEvents `time` attribute — when the event happened

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that produced this event (null for system-produced)

processed.description: Timestamp when EventService finished fan-out for this event

event_message.title: EventMessage
event_message.summary: A delivery record for an Event-to-Subscription match
event_message.description: An EventMessage is created when an Event matches an EventSubscription. It tracks delivery state per (Event × Subscription × Consumer) tuple. See local ADR-013.

eventId.description: Legacy integer FK to event (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008; cleanup tracked at #821)

event.description: FK to source event (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=CASCADE — when the source Event is destroyed, all delivery records cascade-delete with it)

consumerId.description: Legacy integer FK to consumer (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

consumer.description: FK to subscriber consumer (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=SET NULL — when a Consumer is destroyed, delivery records remain for audit but lose their consumer pointer)

subscriptionId.description: Legacy integer FK to event_subscription (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

subscription.description: FK to matching subscription (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=CASCADE — when a Subscription is destroyed, its in-flight delivery records cascade-delete)

payload.description: Materialised payload sent to the consumer (may differ from raw event data after mapping)

lastResponse.description: Most recent response from the consumer (status, headers, body)

lastAttempt.description: Timestamp of most recent delivery attempt

nextAttempt.description: Scheduled time of next retry (null when terminal state reached)

event_subscription.title: EventSubscription
event_subscription.description: An EventSubscription pairs a Consumer with an event-type filter (CloudEvents Subscription API). When a matching Event occurs, an EventMessage is generated. See local ADR-013.

types.description: List of CloudEvents type filters (any-of match)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that owns the subscription

job.title: Job
job.description: A Job is a scheduled task discovered by Nextcloud's `\OCP\BackgroundJob\TimedJob` subclass (JobTask). See local ADR-014 for the cron/job execution model.

jobClass.description: PHP class name implementing the job logic

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the job class at invocation

interval.description: Cron interval in seconds between runs

timeSensitive.description: Whether this job has a hard scheduling window

allowParallelRuns.description: Whether multiple instances may run concurrently

singleRun.description: Whether this is a one-shot job (auto-disabled after success)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that owns the job (null for system jobs)

jobListId.description: Nextcloud job-list reference for cross-system tracking

logRetention.description: Per-job override for success log retention (seconds)

errorRetention.description: Per-job override for error log retention (seconds)

configurations.description: Configuration profile slugs this job participates in

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.summary: A transformation rule from one schema to another
mapping.description: A Mapping defines a transformation between two object shapes. Used by Endpoints (input/output mapping), Synchronizations (source-target mapping), and Rules. See local ADR-002.
The field-to-field transformation rules (Twig templates or property paths)

unset.description: Field paths to remove from the output

passThrough.description: Whether unmapped fields flow through to the output

rule.title: Rule
rule.summary: A conditional pipeline step applied to an Endpoint or Synchronization
rule.description: A Rule encodes a conditional action applied at a specific timing point in an Endpoint or Synchronization pipeline. See local ADR-011 for the FlowToken context that rules read/write.

timing.description: Pipeline timing slot (pre-request, post-request, pre-response, post-response)

conditions.description: JsonLogic expression tree (canonical top-level object shape, e.g. {"and": [{"var": ["user.email"]}]}). Backend evaluator (jwadhams/json-logic-php) accepts either object or array; the schema mandates object to match what the visual builder emits.

order.description: Execution order within its timing slot

synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.summary: A bidirectional or unidirectional sync between two systems
synchronization.description: A Synchronization is one half of the Source/Sync/Contract triad (see local ADR-005). It defines what to sync (sourceId/targetId), how to compare (sourceHashMapping), and per-pass state (currentPage, last-checked timestamps). The `sourceId`/`targetId` fields have an overloaded format documented inline.

sourceId.description: Polymorphic source identifier. Overloaded format: (1) numeric string `'42'` = legacy integer Source PK; (2) `register/schema` slug pair = OR-internal source; (3) UUID string = post-chain-B canonical OR identifier. Chain B's migrator branches on the format to translate (1) to (3). Cross-ref: chain-B REQ on sourceId 3-format branching.

sourceHash.description: Hash of last-known source state (for change detection)

sourceHashMapping.description: Mapping slug used to compute the source hash

sourceTargetMapping.description: Mapping slug for source-to-target field transformation

sourceLastChanged.description: Most recent change timestamp from the source side

sourceLastChecked.description: Most recent successful check of the source

sourceLastSynced.description: Most recent successful sync from the source

currentPage.description: Pagination cursor for in-flight sync passes

targetId.description: Polymorphic target identifier. Same overloaded format as `sourceId`.

targetSourceMapping.description: Mapping slug for target-to-source reverse transformation (bidirectional sync)

targetLastChanged.description: Most recent change timestamp from the target side

targetLastChecked.description: Most recent successful check of the target

targetLastSynced.description: Most recent successful sync to the target

followUps.description: Synchronization slugs to trigger after this one completes

synchronization_contract.title: SynchronizationContract
synchronization_contract.summary: Per-object sync state between an origin and target
synchronization_contract.description: A SynchronizationContract is one row per (Synchronization × origin object), recording the per-object identity mapping and last-sync state. The third leg of the Source/Sync/Contract triad — see local ADR-005.

synchronizationId.description: Legacy string FK to synchronization (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

originId.description: Origin-side object identifier (UUID or external system id)

originHash.description: Hash of the origin-side object payload at last sync

sourceLastChanged.description: Most recent change timestamp on the origin side

sourceLastChecked.description: Most recent successful check of the origin object

sourceLastSynced.description: Most recent successful sync from origin

targetHash.description: Hash of the target-side object payload at last sync

targetLastChanged.description: Most recent change timestamp on the target side

targetLastChecked.description: Most recent successful check of the target object

targetLastSynced.description: Most recent successful sync to target

targetLastAction.description: Most recent action applied to the target (created, updated, deleted)

sourceId.description: Deprecated alias for `originId` — retained for backwards compatibility per chain-A REQ-A-008

sourceHash.description: Deprecated alias for `originHash` — retained for backwards compatibility per chain-A REQ-A-008

call_log.title: CallLog
call_log.summary: Append-only log of outbound HTTP calls
call_log.description: A CallLog is the primary observability surface for outbound HTTP calls. Every CallService outbound request produces exactly one CallLog row. Append-only and immutable per local ADR-003.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the upstream

statusMessage.description: Reason phrase or short error description

request.description: Captured outbound request (method, URL, headers, body)

sourceId.description: Legacy integer FK to source (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008; cleanup tracked at #821)

source.description: FK to originating Source (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=SET NULL — when a Source is destroyed, its CallLog rows remain for audit but lose their source pointer)

actionId.description: Polymorphic integer FK to the action that triggered this call. Target schema unresolved — see chain-B DEFERRED Q2.

synchronizationId.description: Legacy integer FK to synchronization (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

synchronization.description: FK to originating Synchronization (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=SET NULL — when a Synchronization is destroyed, its CallLog rows remain for audit)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id at the time of the call (null for system calls)

sessionId.description: Session token for correlating multi-call traces

expires.description: Computed retention horizon — when this log row becomes eligible for archival

size.description: Combined request+response byte size for storage accounting

rules.reason: Successful CallLogs retained for one hour for short-term observability — matches JobService::DEFAULT_SUCCESS_LOG_RETENTION (3600 s).
Error CallLogs retained for 30 days for debugging + incident review — matches JobService::DEFAULT_ERROR_LOG_RETENTION (2592000 s).

job_log.title: JobLog
job_log.description: A JobLog records one entry per job invocation (or per significant intra-job event). Append-only and immutable per local ADR-003. Retention split by `level` per chain-A REQ-A-004.

jobId.description: Legacy string FK to job (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

jobClass.description: PHP class that executed the job (denormalised for log archival)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id (null for system jobs)

lastRun.description: Job's lastRun snapshot at log time

nextRun.description: Job's nextRun snapshot at log time

size.description: Approximate row size for storage accounting

rules.reason: Info JobLogs retained for one hour — matches DEFAULT_SUCCESS_LOG_RETENTION.
Warning + error JobLogs retained for 30 days — matches DEFAULT_ERROR_LOG_RETENTION.

synchronization_log.title: SynchronizationLog
synchronization_log.description: A SynchronizationLog records one entry per synchronization pass (or significant event within a pass). Append-only and immutable per local ADR-003.

synchronizationId.description: Legacy string FK to synchronization (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

result.description: Sync pass result summary (counts, errors, durations)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that triggered the sync (null for cron-triggered)

test.description: Whether this entry comes from a dry-run/test execution

force.description: Whether this entry comes from a forced (skip-hash) execution

size.description: Approximate row size for storage accounting

rules.reason: Successful sync logs retained for one hour.
Error sync logs retained for 30 days.

synchronization_contract_log.title: SynchronizationContractLog
synchronization_contract_log.summary: Append-only log of per-object sync results
synchronization_contract_log.description: A SynchronizationContractLog records one entry per (SynchronizationContract × sync pass) — i.e. per object processed. Append-only and immutable per local ADR-003.

synchronizationId.description: Legacy string FK to synchronization (kept during transition per chain-A REQ-A-008)

synchronizationContractId.description: Legacy string FK to synchronization_contract (kept during transition)

synchronization_contract.description: FK to per-object contract (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=CASCADE — when a Contract is destroyed, all its log rows cascade-delete)

synchronizationLogId.description: Legacy string FK to synchronization_log (kept during transition)

synchronization_log.description: FK to parent synchronization_log entry (UUID; many-to-one)

source.description: Source-side object payload snapshot at sync time

target.description: Target-side object payload snapshot at sync time

targetResult.description: Action taken on target (created, updated, deleted, skipped, error)

userId.description: Nextcloud user id that triggered the sync

test.description: Whether this entry comes from a dry-run/test execution

force.description: Whether this entry comes from a forced execution

size.description: Approximate row size for storage accounting

rules.reason: Successful per-object sync results retained for one hour.
Error + delete per-object sync results retained for 30 days.

ris_sync_record.title: RIS Sync Record
ris_sync_record.summary: Audit record for iBabs/NotuBiz synchronisation operations
ris_sync_record.description: A RIS Sync Record tracks each outbound push or inbound pull between OpenConnector and an iBabs or NotuBiz raadsinformatiesysteem. Provides a full audit trail for Archiefwet compliance. See openspec/changes/ibabs-notubiz-connector/specs/ibabs-notubiz-connector/spec.md#REQ-RIS-033.

risDocumentId.description: Document or vergaderstuk ID in the RIS

errorMessage.description: Error details if status is failed

documents.description: List of document references (Nextcloud file ID + RIS doc ID)

sourceId.description: UUID of the Source entity used for this sync
